items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: And I would say that the middle aged people went and moved for Tubi.

ctx.x: How about back in the 20s, did you notice a great difference between the music that the young people wanted, the style that they wanted, as opposed to the more middle aged people that catered to different tastes?

I'll tell you the truth. With a Dixieland band such as mine, we didn't worry about what they wanted. We played what we wanted. We were a Dixieland band, see? But when I went into the Forest Grill, I started getting the young college people, and I catered to them, so I would mix in a slow tune now and then. But they danced everything, you know? And I would say that the middle aged people went and moved for Tubi. Because when I used to play the alumni dances, then I had to load a band down.
But I wouldn't play them with a Dixieland band.
